strings.autoenablenotification:
In Moodle 4.0 onwards, the MoodleNet integration is enabled by default in Advanced features. Users with the capability to create and manage activities can browse MoodleNet via the activity chooser and import MoodleNet resources into their courses.

If desired, an alternative MoodleNet instance may be specified in the MoodleNet inbound settings.
strings.browsecontentmoodlenet: Or browse for content on MoodleNet
strings.defaultmoodlenet_desc: The URL of the MoodleNet instance available via the activity chooser.
strings.defaultmoodlenetname_desc: The name of the MoodleNet instance available via the activity chooser.
strings.enablemoodlenet_desc: If enabled, a user with the capability to create and manage activities can browse MoodleNet via the activity chooser and import MoodleNet resources into their course. In addition, a user with the capability to restore backups can select a backup file on MoodleNet and restore it into Moodle.
